svg.text: Decomposing a complex signal into its constituent frequencies
= sum of component sine waves below:
Integrating f(t) against a rotating complex exponential e⁻i2πƒt extracts the amplitude at each frequency ƒ.
Used in: 🎵 Audio / Music · 📷 JPEG / PNG compression · 🧪 MRI imaging · 📡 Wireless communications · 🔭 Astronomy
